creator: noevarner.ai
title: Replace a $400/mo Instagram posting hire: connect your social accounts to a scheduler SaaS ('Zernio' as transcribed), generate an API key, add its MCP to Claude, and have Claude post to up to 20 accounts

tools.name: Zernio (name as heard in transcript; spelling unverified)
tools.detail: Social scheduler with a Connections page (Bluesky, Instagram, Pinterest, Telegram, LinkedIn, Threads, X...) and an API key; exposes an MCP server

tools.name: Claude (MCP connector)
tools.detail: Connect the scheduler's MCP to Claude so Claude posts on your behalf

claims: Someone offered $400/month ($100/week) for a human to upload posts to one Instagram account
You can connect 20 Instagram accounts (and 'a thousand accounts' per the hook) to one scheduler profile
After connecting the MCP, Claude posts to all connected accounts for free
how_to_steps: Create an account on the scheduler ('Zernio')
On its Connections page, connect every social profile you want to post to (Instagram, Bluesky, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Threads, X, Telegram...)
Create an API key in the scheduler
Add the scheduler's MCP server to Claude
Ask Claude to post content; it publishes to all connected accounts
on_screen_only: Stitched clip of @JACOB_SULLIVAN05: 'Hiring IG account manager / Will pay $400/mo'

Scheduler UI: 'Connections -- Manage profiles and platform integrations', 'Platforms', 'Default Profile', Bluesky (Not connected / Connect), Instagram (Connected, @noevarner.ai, Disconnect), Pinterest, Telegram, plus more rows; browser URL partially visible ending in '...nio.com/...connections?profile=...'
Secondary tab bar in the scheduler: Google, Funnel, Instagram, Social media, AI Tools (hard to read)

relevance.why: Haji may want automated posting for his own businesses, but the liked set already has Postiz (open-source) and this is a thin lead-gen pitch for an unverified hosted tool with no pricing shown.

implement_score.why: If social autoposting is wanted, the pattern (scheduler with MCP + Claude) is right, but Postiz (already liked, open-source, MCP support) is the better-vetted route. Only pursue the named tool after confirming it exists and its cost.

verify: What is the actual product name/URL (transcribed as 'Zernio', screen shows '...nio.com')? Does it have an MCP server and pricing?
Instagram API: posting to 20 accounts from one tool requires Business/Creator accounts via Meta Graph API -- is 'connect 20 IG accounts' realistic and ToS-safe?
Does Claude (chat) support this MCP via Connectors, or is it Claude Code only?

gap.what: Variant of liked Postiz content (Claude as social media manager via an MCP-enabled scheduler); only new element is an unverified hosted tool name.
